description: This file defines the class `HTMLPurifier_Context`, which manages a context object for the HTML Purifier library. It handles registration, retrieval, destruction, and existence check for variables stored in a private array, enabling contextual data management within the library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Context
classes.description: A registry object that contains information about the current processing context, managing variables via references.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a variable by reference into the context with a specified name.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a variable reference by name, optionally ignoring errors if the variable does not exist.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes a variable from the context by name.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a variable with the specified name exists in the context.

methods.name: loadArray
methods.description: Loads multiple variables from an associative array into the context.
